title: Student Transportation Services Courtesy Permit Fee Schedule: Billed Share of the Permit Period by Posting Day
content:
Under the Student Transportation Services courtesy permit fee schedule, the billed share of the permit period depends on the posting day and on the permit. The posting day is the application date, or the signing day for a seat offered from the waiting list. The first school day is August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester permit and January 6, 2027 for a spring semester permit.

| Posting day and permit | Billed share |
|---|---|
| before the first school day of the permit period, any permit | one, the whole period |
| on or after that day, Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | the whole calendar months from the month of posting through May, that month included, divided by the 10 months of the permit period |
| on or after that day, Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | the calendar days from the posting day to the period's last day (December 31, 2026 or May 31, 2027), divided by the calendar days from the period's first school day to its last day (141 for the fall semester, 145 for the spring semester) |

## Both sides of the first school day (hypothetical)

| Permit | Posting day | Billed share |
|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | August 11, 2026 | 1 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | August 12, 2026 | August through May, 10 divided by 10: 1 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | October 15, 2026 | October through May, 8 divided by 10: 0.8 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), spring | January 5, 2027 | 1 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), spring | February 1, 2027 | 119 divided by 145: 0.820690 |
